description: Primitive crystal structure and allowed degrees of freedom (DoF).

rows.name: basis
rows.description: Basis site descriptions.

rows.name: coordinate_mode
rows.description: Basis site coordinate type. One of: "Fractional", "Direct", or "Cartesian".

rows.name: description

rows.name: dofs
rows.description: Continuous global DoF (optional).

rows.name: lattice_vectors
rows.description: Lattice vectors (as row vectors), in Angstroms.

rows.name: species
rows.description: Fixed atom properties and molecule definitions (optional).

rows.name: title
rows.description: Project title. Must consist of alphanumeric characters and underscores only. The first character may not be a number.

rows.name: coordinate
rows.description: Site coordinate with units as specified by coordinate_mode.

rows.name: dofs
rows.description: Continuous site DoF (optional).

rows.name: label
rows.description: An integer, >= 0, that distinguishes otherwise identical sites (optional).

rows.name: occupants
rows.description: Allowed occupant species at this site (optional, default=["UNKNOWN"]).

description: A crystal structure of atomic or molecular occupants with associated properties.

rows.name: atom_coords
rows.description: Atom coordinates.

rows.name: atom_type
rows.description: Atom type names.

rows.name: atom_properties
rows.description: Continuous properties associated with individual atoms (optional).

rows.name: coordinate_mode
rows.description: Coordinate type for atom and molecule coordinates. One of: "Fractional", "Direct", or "Cartesian".

rows.name: lattice_vectors
rows.description: Lattice vectors (as row vectors), in Angstroms.

rows.name: mol_coords
rows.description: Molecule coordinates (optional).

rows.name: mol_type
rows.description: Molecule type names (optional).

rows.name: mol_properties
rows.description: Continuous properties associated with individual molecules (optional).

rows.name: global_properties
rows.description: Continuous properties associated with the entire crystal (optional).

rows.name: value
rows.description: Property value. For atom and molecule properties, an array of vectors, one per atom or molecule. For global properties, a scalar or vector. Dimensions must match the standard dimension of the CASM property type.

description: An atomic component of a molecular occupant.

rows.name: coordinate
rows.description: Position of the atom, relative to the basis site. Coordinate mode is the same as the enclosing Prim or Structure.

rows.name: name
rows.description: Atom type name.

rows.name: properties
rows.description: Fixed atomic properties, such as magnetic moment or selective dynamics flags (optional).

rows.name: value
rows.description: Species attribute value. Dimension must match the standard dimension of the CASM property type.

description: A site occupant, which may be a vacancy, single atom, or molecule.

rows.name: atoms
rows.description: List of atoms that comprise a molecule (optional, may be excluded for single-atom occupants).

rows.name: name
rows.description: Chemical name of the species (optional, used to override the key in the species dict).

rows.name: properties
rows.description: Fixed molecular properties, such as magnetic spin or selective dynamics flags (optional).

rows.name: value
rows.description: Species attribute value. Dimension must match the standard dimension of the CASM property type.

description: The basis for a set of degrees of freedom (DoF). In Prim JSON, this appears as a dict mapping DoF type names to their specifications.

rows.name: axis_names
rows.description: Names for the individual DoF basis vectors. Required if basis is present. Size must match the number of rows in basis.

rows.name: basis
rows.description: Row-vector matrix defining the user-specified basis in terms of the standard basis (optional, default is the standard basis).

description: A symmetry operation, represented as a transformation matrix, translation vector, and time reversal flag.

rows.name: matrix
rows.description: Coordinate transformation matrix.

rows.name: tau
rows.description: Coordinate translation vector.

rows.name: time_reversal
rows.description: Whether the symmetry operation includes time reversal.

description: Symmetry operation type, axis, invariant point, and other descriptive information.

rows.name: angle
rows.description: Rotation angle in degrees.

rows.name: brief
rows.description: Brief string descriptions of the symmetry operation in Cartesian (CART) and fractional (FRAC) coordinates.

rows.name: conjugacy_class
rows.description: Index of the conjugacy class containing this operation.

rows.name: invariant_point
rows.description: A Cartesian coordinate that is invariant under the operation (does not exist for identity).

rows.name: inverse_operation
rows.description: Index in the group of the inverse operation.

rows.name: mirror_normal
rows.description: Unit normal vector of mirror and glide planes (Cartesian).

rows.name: rotation_angle
rows.description: Rotation angle of the operation (degrees).

rows.name: rotation_axis
rows.description: Rotation axis (Cartesian, normalized to length 1).

rows.name: shift
rows.description: Screw or glide shift vector (Cartesian).

rows.name: type
rows.description: Symmetry operation type: "identity", "mirror", "glide", "rotation", "screw", "inversion", "rotoinversion", or "invalid".
